title: VLAILA Experiment Knowledge Base Entry
description: Ground truth for one Virtual Labs experiment. Everything VLAILA knows about an experiment lives here: the correct procedure, what counts as an error, the theory corpus used for grounded Q&A, and the quiz bank. Authored by a domain expert; never inferred by a model.

experiment_id.description: Matches <meta name="experiment-short-name"> on the live experiment page.

lab_id.description: Stable slug for the parent lab.

origin.description: Live lab origin, e.g. https://pp-iiith.vlabs.ac.in. Used with experiment_id as the auto-lookup key so the embedded widget needs no configuration.

institute.description: Developing institute code, e.g. IIITH, IITR.

tasks.description: Ordered task pages, matching <meta name="task-name"> on each page. Most labs use the classic eight (Aim, Theory, Pretest, Procedure, Simulation, Posttest, References, Feedback), but learning-unit labs such as ds1-iiith define their own (Demo, Practice, Exercise, Quiz, ...), so any string is accepted.

prerequisites.description: Experiments or concepts a student should have met first. Surfaced as a soft pre-flight check, never a hard block.

why.description: One line: what breaks without it.

experiment_ref.description: Optional experiment_id of the prerequisite lab exercise.

steps.description: The correct procedure, in order. Step order defines what 'out of sequence' means.

task.description: Must appear in tasks[]. Matched against <meta name="task-name"> to know which page the step lives on.

requires.description: Step ids that must be completed first.

milestone.description: Completing this is a good moment for a CONCEPT reinforcement prompt.

expected_dwell_seconds.description: Below this, the student likely skimmed rather than read. Used for gentle HINTs, never WARNs.

stuck_after_seconds.description: No qualifying interaction for this long on the active step => student may be stuck.

hints.description: Three escalation levels. Level 1 asks, level 2 tells, level 3 shows.

highlight.description: CSS selector to ring in the live UI.

concept.description: 2-3 sentence 'why did this happen' micro-lesson offered at milestones.

errors.description: Authored error patterns. Matched deterministically by the rules engine - no model involved, so these never fire spuriously.

severity.description: fatal = cannot obtain valid results without correcting; recoverable = can proceed but results may vary. A pedagogical judgement, so it is authored, not inferred.

correction_step.description: Step id the student should go to.

theory_chunks.description: Retrieval corpus for experiment-scoped Q&A. Grounded in the live lab's own Theory/Procedure pages. The retriever never sees chunks from another experiment.

source.description: URL of the live page this was drawn from.

quiz_bank.description: Source for the post-experiment 3-question reflection quiz. Answers are authored and verified, never model-generated, so feedback is always correct.

frame.description: Where the selector lives. 'host' = the experiment page itself; 'sim' = the same-origin simulator iframe (#fraDisabled); 'sim:<name>' = a nested simulator frame.

detector.description: How the Screen Observer recognises this step being performed.

task.description: For action=navigate: the task page whose arrival satisfies this step.

condition.description: All present keys must hold (logical AND). Absent keys are ignored.

on_task.description: Only fires while this task page is open.

unless_completed.description: Fires only if NONE of these step ids are complete - the out-of-order detector.

after_completed.description: Fires only if ALL of these step ids are complete.

repeat_count.description: Fires only after the same action repeats this many times - the thrashing detector.

idle_seconds.description: Fires after this long with no qualifying interaction.
